parent_question: Does sharing more of the same sampled landscape make post-IBD phylogeographic structure more recurrent across lineages?
scope: Fresh response-blind Insecta panel; continuous symmetric 500-km geographic co-opportunity; source-target roles species-disjoint.

confirmatory_positive.trigger: Confirmatory survivor design passes information and actual-T_st qualification, then one-shot empirical beta_G > 0 with primary calibrated p <= 0.05.
confirmatory_positive.headline: Geographic recurrence is conditional on shared landscape opportunity.
confirmatory_positive.biological_reading: The weak all-species recurrence in the completed 211-species test is at least partly explained by whether lineages actually sample the same landscape. Among codistributed lineages, greater overlap in sampled geography predicts greater reuse of post-IBD spatial genetic information.
allowed_claims: a reusable place component exists within the qualified codistributed insect domain

shared geographic opportunity is predictive of cross-lineage recurrence beyond source identity, target identity, sampling imbalance, same-order membership, centroid proximity, and the declared private-geometry null
comparative phylogeographic concordance becomes more predictable when exposure to the same landscape is explicitly represented
prohibited_claims: a named mountain, river, refugium, ecotone, or geological event caused the recurrence
geographic barriers are universal across insects or animals
G_st measures historical coexistence or temporal co-occurrence

confirmatory_qualified_null.trigger: Confirmatory survivor design passes information and actual-T_st qualification, but the one-shot empirical beta_G is not positive at the calibrated alpha.
confirmatory_qualified_null.headline: Sharing the same landscape is not sufficient to make phylogeographic structure reusable across lineages.
confirmatory_qualified_null.biological_reading: The broad 211-species non-transfer result cannot be explained simply by species occupying different places. Even among insect lineages with greater mutual geographic sampling opportunity, post-IBD spatial structure remains predominantly lineage-conditioned at the tested scale.
allowed_claims: simple geographic co-opportunity is insufficient to restore cross-lineage recurrence in the qualified domain
the same sampled landscape need not imply the same effective phylogeographic barrier structure
future mechanism tests should target lineage-by-place interactions such as dispersal, habitat dependence, and historical range dynamics rather than search for one universal barrier map
prohibited_claims: no biologically coherent subset could ever share barriers

not_evaluable.trigger: Any required response-blind information, private-null Type-I, shared-positive power, character-mask, or survivor-geometry gate fails.
not_evaluable.headline: No biological inference on codistribution-conditioned recurrence.
not_evaluable.biological_reading: The proposed relation cannot be adjudicated under the realized design and frozen estimator.
prohibited_claims: positive or negative biological interpretation of beta_G

relation_to_completed_211_species_result.completed_result: Within-species spatial structure detectable; broad post-IBD geographic field not detectably transferable across unseen species.
relation_to_completed_211_species_result.rule: The successor can explain or refine the domain of the completed result but may not reclassify, retune, or replace it.
